name: zcrew
description: Watches ZCode worker runs for Claude Code: waits so the model does not, shows progress beside the prompt, runs zcrew gate and wakes Claude when work is ready to review.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the band, pane and notifications (Thai or English).

handsFree.title: Hands-free waiting
handsFree.description: Answer agent-wait at once and wake Claude when a run ends, instead of letting the model poll every minute.

showUsage.title: Show Claude usage
showUsage.description: Keep the status line showing context fill and the 5-hour / weekly rate-limit windows, even with no runs active.

python.title: Python command
python.description: Python used to run zcrew (python on Windows, python3 elsewhere).

zcrewScript.title: zcrew.py path
zcrewScript.description: Full path of zcrew.py; empty means ZCREW_HOME or ~/.zcrew, then src/scripts/zcrew.py.
